title: Implemented Visualization for MVP Tool
situation: The internal MVP tool at created models by making API calls to multiple sistems. Manual checks were done after creation to ensure everything was created correctly. It was time-consuming and prone to errors.
action: - Designed a simplified JSON representation of the created models, capturing key attributes and relationships.; - Visualization tool to transform the JSON representation into a graph-like view, allowing faster inspections of what relationships and attributes.
result: Enabled faster verification and more accurate models
